disposition_reason: Reports measured Pb, Cd, As, Cr, Ni and Al concentrations in five individual honey samples (mg/kg) by AAS; all per-sample values printed in Table 1.
disposition_locator: Table 1 (Values of metals studied in honey, mg/kg), p.40

study.design: small convenience survey (4 beekeeper samples + 1 supermarket sample)
study.material_scope: unprocessed honeys of casual flower type; 4 from beekeepers, 1 retail (supermarket, Skopje)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Table 1/2 footnotes: samples 1 and 4 beekeepers in Kumanovo (North Macedonia), sample 2 beekeeper in Skopje, sample 3 beekeeper in Preshevo (Serbia), sample 5 bought in a Skopje supermarket (production origin of sample 5 not stated). Section 2.1 instead says '4 samples were from the Macedonian market, from different suppliers one of which was from store in Skopje and one sample from Presevo' (internal inconsistency).
study.method: Microwave digestion (Milestone Ultra Wave) with 65% HNO3; AAS (Perkin-Elmer AAnalyst 600)
study.lod_loq: Not reported for any analyte; non-detects printed as 'nd'.
study.basis: Not stated; assumed as-received honey (mg/kg honey).
study.qa: No CRM, recovery, or replicate information reported.

controls.control: Compliance check against Macedonian national maximum levels for honey (Pb 0.5, Cd 0.03, As 0.5 mg/kg)
controls.outcome: All Pb below 0.5 mg/kg; sample 1 Cd 0.040 mg/kg above 0.03 mg/kg

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary states four beekeeper samples and one supermarket sample; this matches the abstract and table footnotes but the primary's own section 2.1 says 4 samples were from the Macedonian market from different suppliers (one from a Skopje store) plus one from Presevo. Summary does not flag this internal inconsistency.
Summary labels As as 'total arsenic'; the primary only says 'As' by AAS (no speciation). Treating it as total As is an inference, not a stated fact.
Summary repeats the author range Zn 0.067-0.085 mg/kg without noting sample 2 Zn is nd (not an HMI analyte; noted for accuracy only).
Summary describes values as 'as-sold honey basis'; the primary does not state a basis and 4 of 5 samples came directly from beekeepers, not retail sale.
unresolved: No LOD/LOQ reported, so non-detect bounds for Cd, As, Cr, Ni cannot be stated.
Text sentence 'Cd and Cu were detected in samples 1 and 3' is literally inaccurate (Cd only detected in sample 1; Cu detected in all); interpreted as exceedances (Cd sample 1, Cu sample 3).
Non-HMI elements Fe, Mn, Cu, Zn, Se in Table 1 were not extracted (outside the analyte list).
